firstRows:
archaeal-type flagellum

A non-membrane-bounded motility organelle, also called the archaellum, characterized in Archaea and in the bacterium Litorilinea aerophila; a membrane-associated motor drives swimming through rotation of extracellular type-IV-pilin-like archaellin filaments.

	GO:0097589	Appendage	Appendage	Proposed

MitoStore

A transient cytosolic protein granule characterized in budding yeast that sequesters non-imported mitochondrial precursor proteins, is enriched for presequence-containing cargo and associates with the mitochondrial surface.

	cellstructuremech:mitostore	Inclusion	Inclusion body	Proposed

9+2 motile cilium

A motile cilium where the axoneme has a ring of nine outer microtubule doublets plus two central microtubules (and is therefore called a 9+2 axoneme). A canonical motile cilium (or eukaryotic flagellum) whose axoneme consists of nine peripheral microtubule doublets surrounding a central pair of singlet microtubules (the 9+2 arrangement). Conserved across Chlamydomonas reinhardtii, Tetrahymena thermophila, and Trypanosoma brucei, the 9+2 motile cilium integrates central pair projections, radial spokes, nexin-dynein regulatory complexes, and dynein arms to produce planar or ciliary waveforms.

	GO:0097729	Appendage	Appendage	Proposed

archaeal cannula

An extracellular hollow tubular archaeal cell projection, characterized in Pyrodictium species, that extends from the cell envelope as a proteinaceous filament and forms networks between cells.

	cellstructuremech:archaeal_cannula	Appendage	Appendage	Proposed

archaeal-type flagellum

A non-membrane-bounded motility organelle, also called the archaellum, characterized in Archaea and in the bacterium Litorilinea aerophila; a membrane-associated motor drives swimming through rotation of extracellular type-IV-pilin-like archaellin filaments.

	GO:0097589	Appendage	Appendage	Proposed

zeta DNA polymerase complex

An error-prone eukaryotic DNA polymerase complex that carries out translesion DNA synthesis and damage-tolerance mutagenesis; in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, DNA polymerase zeta contains Rev3, Rev7, and the Pol31 and Pol32 accessory subunits shared with DNA polymerase delta.

	GO:0016035	Other	Multiprotein complex	Proposed

Y-shaped link

A Y-shaped protein complex in the ciliary transition zone that connects the cilium axoneme to the ciliary necklace. Both protein sorting and protein gating occur at this point in the cilium allowing some, but not all proteins to enter the cilium.

	GO:0097537	Appendage	Multiprotein complex	Proposed

Woronin body

A peroxisome-derived dense-core vesicle of filamentous fungi that seals septal pores upon hyphal wounding.
